rule: SmartLic is donor, URL-specific migration bridge and sunset evidence only. Classification never authorizes a SmartLic public runtime or a new capability.

capabilities.label: Defesa de margem e BDI
capabilities.current_truth: The canonical CONFENGE vertical and utility already exist in web-cfg; #60 retains only live commercial proof.
capabilities.justification: This is the chosen first vertical and has direct commercial relevance without preserving SmartLic runtime.
capabilities.data_dependency: None for the public surface; a real consented event is required only for live proof.
capabilities.promotion_gate: No expansion before one real page-to-action outcome is observed.

capabilities.label: Análises contratuais com autoria, evidência e comparáveis
capabilities.current_truth: The canary family and consumer are in web-cfg; #83 owns only the contemporary canary residual.
capabilities.justification: Selective analysis can compound authority from extra-cli facts without becoming a generic portal.
capabilities.data_dependency: Versioned SELECT-only public-read facts, comparables, provenance and freshness from extra-cli.
capabilities.promotion_gate: Finish and observe the existing canary before another contract-analysis family.

capabilities.label: Resposta pública answer-first
capabilities.current_truth: One narrow CONFENGE canary is the maximum next slice; the SmartLic Q&A corpus is not a migration queue.
capabilities.justification: The mechanism may acquire non-branded demand only when a distinct answer, provenance and maintenance owner exist.
capabilities.data_dependency: A named question, demand evidence or UNKNOWN, answerable public-read dataset and editorial approval.
capabilities.promotion_gate: Promote only after the active #83 canary closes and one question passes the #84 editorial/data gate.

capabilities.label: Consulta de contratos e preços
capabilities.current_truth: Public-read facts may support evidence drill-down; a generic explorer is not authorized.
capabilities.justification: A portal would create maintenance and indexation risk before a narrow visitor job proves commercial learning.
capabilities.data_dependency: Versioned contract/price public-read plus coverage, freshness, provenance and publication authorization.
capabilities.promotion_gate: A proven Market Answer or contract-analysis canary must demonstrate demand for a specific drill-down job.

capabilities.label: Hubs de consulta de CNPJ, fornecedor, órgão e município
capabilities.current_truth: Only the four exact hub URLs remain on hold; combinatorial entity pages remain retired.
capabilities.justification: A narrow entity lookup may become useful, but it has no authorized visitor job or public-read contract today.
capabilities.data_dependency: A named lookup job, a versioned extra-cli public-read contract, freshness and a distinct-utility gate.
capabilities.promotion_gate: Promote only a narrow hub after an explicit issue and utility gate; never revive entity-page farms.

capabilities.label: Perfis combinatórios de entidades
capabilities.current_truth: Static entity-page farms remain retired; contextual X-Ray may answer a named user job without reviving them.
capabilities.justification: Entity substitution is thin utility and page count is not an outcome.
capabilities.data_dependency: No dependency can promote a page farm; any future contextual tool requires its own evidence gate.

capabilities.label: Hub e guias de operação em licitações/PNCP
capabilities.current_truth: The chosen wedge is margin defense; Bid Room is not a 1:1 substitute and the 35 legacy HOLDs stay 410.
capabilities.justification: Historical impressions do not justify rebuilding an entire tender corpus without a promoted mechanism and distinct utility.
capabilities.data_dependency: A commercially ranked recall/utility contract and one promoted acquisition canary.
capabilities.promotion_gate: Founder explicitly promotes tenders after the current vertical and next acquisition canary produce evidence.

capabilities.label: Newsletter/digest SaaS do SmartLic
capabilities.current_truth: Only consent and content lessons may inform #90; no SmartLic audience runtime migrates.
capabilities.justification: The public brand and runtime are forbidden, and #90 is gated on a first Market Answer.
capabilities.promotion_gate: #90 may run a CONFENGE-only manual canary after #84 proof; this capability remains DROP.

capabilities.label: Raio-X, watchlists e inventário doador
capabilities.current_truth: Retained only as donor evidence for URL-level migrate/redirect/retire decisions.
capabilities.justification: The identity and facts authority is extra-cli; SmartLic cannot remain an operational data or public plane.
capabilities.data_dependency: Hash-pinned #62 inventory and SmartLic #2115 bridge evidence.
capabilities.promotion_gate: Never promoted to runtime; remove after the #62/SmartLic #2111 removal trigger.

capabilities.label: GEO/llms.txt hacks
capabilities.current_truth: Search/AI observability may be measured by #86; unsupported ranking hacks are not a capability.
capabilities.justification: Eligibility, citations and referrals matter; unverifiable rank manipulation does not.

capabilities.label: Lead magnets e CRO genérico do SmartLic
capabilities.current_truth: CONFENGE keeps contextual capture and attribution; it does not port the legacy stack.
capabilities.justification: Intent-specific next action is owned by #88 and normalized as CONFENGE_WEB without a second product layer.
capabilities.promotion_gate: None for the generic legacy stack.
